items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022

ctx.x: Joe Lovano was playing with the group and then he was hired for the first night and he sat in and he played and he got up and took a solo and after the night was over Woody come up to me and said, “What do you think?” I says, “Well did you hear his solo?” So he was there for three years. My dear friend.
There’s a marvelous video of you and Joe on “Giant Steps” I think it’s from ’77 or so —
